class.name: NNSTGuard
class.brief_description: Base resource for conditions that gate an [NNSTTransition].
class.description: Assign a built-in guard ([NNSTExpressionGuard], [NNSTStateIsActiveGuard], [NNSTAllOfGuard], [NNSTAnyOfGuard], or [NNSTNotGuard]) to [member NNSTTransition.guard] to control when a transition may fire. To create a custom guard in GDScript, extend this class and override [method on_is_satisfied] and [method on_get_supported_trigger_types].

method.name: get_supported_trigger_types
method.description: Returns the [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] bit mask indicating which changes can affect this guard's result on automatic transitions.

method.name: is_satisfied
method.description: Evaluates the guard and returns [code]true[/code] if the transition may be taken.

method.name: on_get_supported_trigger_types
method.description: Override in a custom guard script to return the [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] flags that should re-evaluate automatic transitions using this guard.

method.name: on_is_satisfied
method.description: Override in a custom guard script to return [code]true[/code] when [param transition] on [param state] should be allowed.
